lines.en: scene green1
: Scene commentary...start!
lines.zh: : 场景解说……开始！

lines.en: : This time, with less sexual assault. Hooray.
lines.zh: : 这次性侵少一点。可喜可贺。

lines.en: Thank you for purchasing the December 2022 Lessons in Love Care Package and welcome to the scene commentary for the main event “Stray Cat!”
lines.zh: 感谢你购买 2022 年 12 月的《Lessons in Love》内容包，欢迎来到主线事件《流浪猫！》的场景解说。

lines.en: I’m your host, creator, and all around hateable guy according to coomers on the Internet...Selebus!
lines.zh: 我是你的主持人、创作者，按照网上那群色批的说法，还是个全方位招人烦的家伙……Selebus！

lines.en: Now, if you’re playing this during the holiday season, first and foremost — I’m sorry.
lines.zh: 如果你是在节日期间玩到这段，首先——我很抱歉。

lines.en: scene green2
: Don’t apologize to them. The less money they spend on friends and family, the more money {i}you’ll{/i} have to spend on all of our medical bills when my uncle’s penis punctures holes in our organs.
lines.zh: : 别跟他们道歉。他们花在朋友和家人身上的钱越少，等我叔叔的鸡巴在我们内脏上戳出洞来的时候，{i}你{/i}就有越多的钱付我们的医药费。

lines.en: : That’s a thing I’m aware of in this universe because I’m Commentary-Ami! A completely distinguishable entity who is totally different from normal Ami! Who exists only because {i}you{/i} want me to!
lines.zh: : 这个宇宙里我当然知道，因为我是解说版 Ami！一个完全区分得开的、和普通 Ami 截然不同的存在！而我之所以存在，只是因为{i}你{/i}想要我存在！

lines.en: : I can’t tell if you’re talking to me or the players.
lines.zh: : 我分不清你是在跟我说话，还是在跟玩家说话。

lines.en: : I’m talking to anyone and everyone who enables normal Ami to keep having sex with her uncle. Thank you for your continued support!
lines.zh: : 我是在对每一个让普通 Ami 能继续和她叔叔做爱的人说话。感谢你们一直以来的支持！

lines.en: : Can I go now? I don’t even like this scene.
lines.zh: : 我可以走了吗？我根本不喜欢这场戏。

lines.en: The reason Maya doesn’t like this scene is because it is one of the very first times in Lessons in Love that her shell begins to crack.
lines.zh: Maya 不喜欢这场戏，是因为这是《Lessons in Love》里她的外壳最早开始裂开的几次之一。

lines.en: : I can hear your thoughts, you know. I’m a part of you after all.
lines.zh: : 我听得到你在想什么，你知道吗。毕竟我是你的一部分。

lines.en: : You all are. Now be quiet and wait for your cue so I can finally get this show on the road.
lines.zh: : 你们都是。现在安静点，等着你们的出场提示，好让我终于把这节目开起来。

lines.en: : Hah...fine.
Now, Stray Cat isn’t exactly a {i}Christmas{/i} event per se...but it involves scarves and buying stuff and the mall so, for the sake of this care package, we can pretend it is.
lines.zh: 《流浪猫》严格来说并不算一个{i}圣诞{/i}事件……但它有围巾、有买东西、有商场，所以为了这个内容包，我们就当它是吧。

lines.en: At this point in the game, Maya is still extremely guarded around Sensei. So when she and Ami take a trip to the mall, she’s a little less than enthused, to say the least.
lines.zh: 游戏进展到这里，Maya 对 Sensei 仍然防得很紧。所以当她和 Ami 一起去商场的时候，说得委婉点，她可算不上热心。

lines.en: It’s shitty enough that she has to watch her best friend constantly fawn over the man that she {i}totally doesn’t have history with{/i}, but to do that on a day that reminds her of better times makes it even worse.
lines.zh: 光是看着她最好的朋友不停对着那个她{i}绝对没有任何过往{/i}的男人献殷勤就已经够糟了，而这事还发生在一个会让她想起美好过往的日子里，就更难受了。

lines.en: The thing is that keeping yourself guarded like Maya does, even if it seems like a good idea at the time, can lead to some unfortunate side effects if anything ever manages to slip through.
lines.zh: 问题是，像 Maya 那样把自己防起来，哪怕当时看着是个好主意，一旦有什么东西钻了进来，就会带来一些不幸的副作用。

lines.en: Imagine you really like the type of pepperoni that curls into a cup when it is cooked-
lines.zh: 想象一下，你特别喜欢那种煮熟后会卷成小杯的意大利辣香肠——

lines.en: : Please do not compare my unending torment to different types of pepperoni. It’s dehumanizing.
lines.zh: : 请不要把我无尽的折磨比作不同种类的意大利辣香肠。这太不把人当人了。

lines.en: : You are a literal cartoon.
lines.zh: : 你可是货真价实的卡通人物。

lines.en: : Tell that to the array of Internet good-guys constantly asking what age I am so they can figure out if it’s morally acceptable to jerk off to me or not.
lines.zh: : 这话你去跟网上那一大票老好人说吧 —— 他们天天问我几岁，好判断对着我打飞机在道德上过不过得去。

lines.en: : I’d love to, but I’m already banned from the Harem Hotel Discord.
lines.zh: : 我也想啊，可我已经被 Harem Hotel 的 Discord 封了。

lines.en: : Ba-dum, tss.
: That’s where we’d put a rimshot sound effect if we weren’t about to spend all of our money on a thing that’s going to make Maya cry.
lines.zh: : 本来这里该配一个「咚嚓」音效的，如果我们不是马上要把所有钱花在一个会让 Maya 哭出来的东西上的话。

lines.en: : Just do it already.
lines.zh: : 那就快点动手吧。

lines.en: : Wait, I didn't finish the pepperoni analogy.
lines.zh: : 等等，我那个辣香肠的比喻还没说完。

lines.en: Imagine you really like the type of pepperoni that curls into a cup when it is cooked, but every pizza place stops serving it.
lines.zh: 想象一下，你特别喜欢那种煮熟后会卷成小杯的意大利辣香肠，但每家披萨店都不卖了。

lines.en: So you go millions of years using only the shitty kind of non-curly pepperoni and grow to accept it.
lines.zh: 于是你几百万年都只能吃那种不会卷的烂货，并且慢慢接受了它。

lines.en: But then, boom. Out of nowhere, the good pepperoni is back and you can't help but break out in tears.
lines.zh: 然后，砰。不知道从哪儿冒出来的，好的辣香肠又回来了，你忍不住当场哭出来。

lines.en: That's what happens to Maya.
lines.zh: Maya 身上发生的就是这个。

lines.en: : Are you happy now?
lines.zh: : 你现在满意了？

lines.en: : Yes. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 对。谢谢。

lines.en: scene green13 with flash
The significance of the green scarf that had been referenced in various bouts of flashing text up until this point is finally made clear.
lines.zh: 到这时为止在一段段闪现文字里被反复提到的那条绿围巾，它的意义终于清楚了。

lines.en: Or at least...as clear as things {i}can{/i} be in Lessons in Love. As the next part of this scene would reveal once and for all that the scarf in question belonged to Maya.
lines.zh: 或者说……在《Lessons in Love》里能有多清楚就有多清楚。因为这场戏接下来会一劳永逸地揭示：那条围巾属于 Maya。

lines.en: Or {i}will{/i} belong to Maya. Time travel is confusing and getting into the details of how it works in different LiL contexts isn’t something I’m about to lock behind a paywall.
lines.zh: 或者说{i}将会{/i}属于 Maya。时间旅行很绕，而要说清它在不同 LiL 情境里怎么运作，我可不打算把这种东西锁在付费墙后面。

lines.en: scene americamaya
But what I {i}will{/i} lock behind a paywall is this picture of loli Maya dressed in Yasu’s first Dorm Wars costume, standing in a watermelon field with an American flag behind her.
lines.zh: 但我{i}确实{/i}要锁在付费墙后面的，是这张萝莉 Maya 的图 —— 穿着 Yasu 的第一套宿舍战争服装，站在西瓜地里，身后一面美国国旗。

lines.en: : This is the weirdest monetization strategy I have ever seen.
lines.zh: : 这是我见过最离谱的变现方式。

lines.en: : Aww! But you looked so cute that time you went to the American watermelon field!
lines.zh: : 哎呀！可你那次去美国西瓜地的时候多可爱啊！

lines.en: : That never happened, Ami.
lines.zh: : 那根本没发生过，Ami。

lines.en: : It happened with {i}Commentary{/i} Ami. I know that because I am her — a completely separate entity from normal Ami.
lines.zh: : 那是和{i}解说版{/i} Ami 发生的。我知道，因为我就是她 —— 一个和普通 Ami 完全独立的存在。

lines.en: : The more you say it, the less we believe it.
lines.zh: : 你说得越多，我们越不信。

lines.en: Sensei, for reasons I’ll let you decipher on your own, purchases two green scarves as part of a sale before having them boxed up by a throwaway character and making his way back to the girls he came here with.
lines.zh: Sensei —— 原因我留给你们自己琢磨 —— 趁着打折买了两条绿围巾，让一个用完就扔的路人角色打包好，然后回到他一起来这儿的那两个女孩身边。

lines.en: scene green24
: Ooh! I love this song!
lines.zh: : 哦哦！我超爱这首歌！

lines.en: But when Maya sees that scarf, everything comes crashing down.
lines.zh: 但当 Maya 看到那条围巾，一切就都塌了。

lines.en: Her guard shatters into a million pieces as she, the same girl who was ready to give up on everything and live a blank life full of nothing but gray, feels {i}doubt{/i} for the first time in eons.
lines.zh: 她的防备碎成了上百万片 —— 那个本来已经准备好放弃一切、过一种只剩灰色的空白人生的女孩，在漫长的岁月之后第一次感到了{i}动摇{/i}。

lines.en: When was the last time she saw this? Felt the fabric on her fingers? And when was the last time she received {i}anything{/i} significant from the man she's watched forever?
lines.zh: 她上一次看到这个是什么时候？上一次用指尖摸到这块布料是什么时候？还有，她上一次从那个她注视了很久很久的男人那里收到{i}任何{/i}有意义的东西，是什么时候？

lines.en: The questions rush in like a dam has burst, leaving Ami and Sensei to do nothing but look down at her and wonder.
lines.zh: 问题像决堤一样涌进来，Ami 和 Sensei 只能低头看着她，不明所以。

lines.en: And {i}fear-{/i} for they, too, were caught off guard by the first of many emotional outbursts disguised as temporary character breaks.
lines.zh: 还有{i}恐惧{/i} —— 因为他们同样被这第一次情绪爆发打了个措手不及，而这样的爆发往后还有很多，只是伪装成了暂时的角色破防。

lines.en: scene meintheroom1 with flash
But it’s that sort of thing that makes the characters in this world so very special.
lines.zh: 但正是这种事，让这个世界里的角色如此特别。

lines.en: You never know what’s lying beneath the surface until everything hits the perfect angle and all of the light flows into them.
lines.zh: 你永远不会知道表面之下藏着什么，直到一切都撞上那个完美的角度、所有的光都灌进他们身上。

lines.en: I mean this in more ways than one.
lines.zh: 这句话我有不止一层意思。

lines.en: But that’s something we’ll leave for another day.
lines.zh: 不过这个我们改天再说。

lines.en: Because it is at this point that I will once again take questions.
lines.zh: 因为到了这里，我又要开始回答问题了。

lines.en: scene meintheroom2
: {b}Question 1: The song “Memories” is used sparingly throughout the game. What made it fit this event in particular?{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}问题一：《Memories》这首歌在游戏里用得很少。是什么让它特别适合这个事件？{/b}

lines.en: : Well, at the risk of sounding like a douchebag- the fact that the event itself involved memories.
lines.zh: : 嗯，冒着听起来像个混蛋的风险 —— 因为这个事件本身就和回忆有关。

lines.en: : The track at the end of this event is one of my favorite in the entire game due to the nostalgic longing of its melody. And there is nothing else that better fits the sound of the end {i}ending{/i} than {i}it.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这个事件结尾的那首曲子是我在整个游戏里最喜欢的之一，因为它的旋律里有一种怀旧的渴望。而没有别的东西，比{i}它{/i}更配得上那结局的{i}收尾声{/i}。

lines.en: : {b}Question 2: Did you have plans for the cat motif to be so strong before this event?{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}问题二：在这个事件之前，你就打算让「猫」这个意象这么重吗？{/b}

lines.en: : Yes, that was always a major part of Maya’s character and was the reason I gave her a bell in the first place.
lines.zh: : 是的，那一直是 Maya 这个角色的重要部分，也是我一开始就给她挂个铃铛的原因。

lines.en: : Her entire presence in this world at {i}this{/i} point in the story is like that of a stray cat. No one knows where she came from. She’s cold, yet caring in her own sort of way...
lines.zh: : 在故事的{i}这个{/i}节点上，她存在于这个世界里的整个状态，就像一只流浪猫。没人知道她从哪儿来。她冷淡，却以自己的方式关心着别人……

lines.en: : And even though she can make herself seem vicious, at the end of the day, she’s just a small creature in a world full of bigger things. And she doesn’t want any of them to hurt her.
lines.zh: : 尽管她能让自己看起来很凶，但说到底，她只是一个置身于一堆更大事物中的小东西。而她不想被它们任何一个伤害。

lines.en: : {b}Question 3: Is it difficult writing characters undergoing emotional turmoil? How do you get yourself in the headspace for that?{/i}
lines.zh: : {b}问题三：写正在经历情绪动荡的角色难吗？你是怎么把自己调到那种状态里的？{/i}

lines.en: : I actually find that one of the easier parts of writing as my love for this story is rooted entirely in my love for the characters and those are the moments in which they are finally free.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得这反而是写作里比较轻松的部分 —— 因为我对这个故事的爱，完全扎根于我对这些角色的爱，而那些正是他们终于获得自由的时刻。

lines.en: : I’m one of many people who were raised and taught that any sort of emotional expression emasculates you or makes you weak. And so I took to expressing myself through {i}others{/i} to avoid that.
lines.zh: : 我和很多人一样，从小被教育：任何形式的情绪表达都会让你不像个男人、让你显得软弱。所以我改成通过{i}别人{/i}来表达自己，以此避开那一点。

lines.en: : All of these characters are extensions of myself and so when {i}they{/i} get to break like this, it’s like {i}me{/i} allowing myself to break. And I don’t think I do that enough.
lines.zh: : 所有这些角色都是我的延伸，所以当{i}他们{/i}能这样崩溃的时候，就像{i}我{/i}允许自己崩溃一次。而我觉得自己这样做得还不够多。

lines.en: : {b}Question 4: Was Ayane ever part of this event or was her being left out of it always the plan?{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}问题四：Ayane 曾经出现在这个事件里吗？还是说把她排除在外一直是你的计划？{/b}

lines.en: : Leaving Ayane out of this event was always the plan and is, in my opinion, one of the more underrated and unspoken aspects of her character as a whole.
lines.zh: : 把 Ayane 排除在这个事件之外一直是我的计划，而且在我看来，这是她整个人物塑造里比较被低估、也比较少被提及的一点。

lines.en: : Think of the significance of the scarf for all three members of the Sensei Love Squad and how it pertains to their respective place in the world.
lines.zh: : 想想那条围巾对 Sensei 亲卫队三个人各自的意义，以及它如何对应她们在世上各自的位置。

lines.en: : Ami, who thinks little of it due to how commonplace and “normal” her ties to Sensei are-
lines.zh: : Ami，因为自己和 Sensei 的关系稀松平常、再「正常」不过，所以不太把它当回事 ——

lines.en: : Maya, who has an extreme emotional connection to it due to the exact opposite-
lines.zh: : Maya，因为完全相反的原因，对它有着极深的情感联结 ——

lines.en: : And Ayane, who just wants to belong and be seen in the same light despite never feeling like she has been.
lines.zh: : 还有 Ayane，她只是想要归属，想要被同样地看见，尽管她从来没觉得自己被看见过。

lines.en: : She was never going to receive a scarf because she {i}needed{/i} to feel those things.
lines.zh: : 她永远不会得到一条围巾，因为她{i}需要{/i}去感受那些东西。

lines.en: : {b}Final Question: Were you worried the audience might grow to dislike Maya due to her first signs of weakness showing up so late in the story?{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}最后一个问题：Maya 第一次露出软弱的一面出现得这么晚，你担心观众会因此讨厌她吗？{/b}

lines.en: : No. In fact, I {i}want{/i} people to dislike characters because not only is the idea of everyone being inherently loved silly, it gives me more room to develop them.
lines.zh: : 不。事实上，我{i}希望{/i}有人讨厌某些角色 —— 因为「每个人天生就该被喜欢」这个想法本身就很蠢，而且这样也给了我更多空间去塑造他们。

lines.en: : The reason Maya’s character is so strong {i}now{/i}, years down the road, is precisely {i}because{/i} of how guarded and powerful she was in the beginning.
lines.zh: : Maya 这个角色在多年后的{i}今天{/i}之所以这么有力量，恰恰{i}是因为{/i}她一开始有多么防备、多么强硬。

lines.en: : Everyone changes over time and I think that the breaking down of one’s personal strength on a journey toward the acceptance of weakness is one of the best ways to write a character.
lines.zh: : 每个人都会随时间改变，而我觉得，让一个人自己的力量崩解、并走向接纳软弱的那段旅程，是写角色最好的方式之一。

lines.en: : If Maya spilled everything she knows from the very beginning...and didn’t take any time at all to warm up to Sensei...she wouldn’t just stop being a good character-
lines.zh: : 如果 Maya 从一开始就把她知道的一切都倒出来……而且一点时间都不花去慢慢接纳 Sensei……那她就不只是不再是个好角色 ——

lines.en: : She’d stop being a stray cat.
lines.zh: : 她也就不再是流浪猫了。

lines.en: : And there would be no Lessons in Love without that.
lines.zh: : 而没有这一点，也就不会有《Lessons in Love》。

lines.en: scene black
Thank you for taking the time out of your day to read the scene commentary for the main event, “Stray Cat.”
lines.zh: 感谢你抽出时间阅读主线事件《流浪猫》的场景解说。

lines.en: Stick around and continue showing your support for more scenes just like this in the future.
lines.zh: 请继续关注，并继续支持未来更多像这样的场景。

lines.en: Selebus, signing off.
lines.zh: Selebus，下线。
